evidence.maf: curated: HPRC release 1 Cactus alignment of 90 human assemblies on hg38 (UCSC hprc90way, Liao et al. 2023)
evidence.hprc_arr: curated: HPRC arrangements relative to hg38 (UCSC hprcArrV1: duplications, inversions, deletions, insertions, double)
evidence.hprc_v21_sv: curated: HPRC release 2 v2.1 structural variants from 233 assemblies (UCSC hprc2v21Sv, minigraph-cactus)
evidence.gnomad_snv: curated: gnomAD v4.1.1 genomes, allele frequencies (AN per site, up to 152,000 alleles)
evidence.gnomad_sv: curated: gnomAD v4.1 structural variants, allele frequencies (AN per site)
evidence.trexplorer: curated: TRExplorer v2 tandem-repeat catalogue, HPRC and TenK10K allele-size histograms
evidence.gtex_dapg: experimental: GTEx v8 fine-mapped cis-eQTLs (DAP-G, UCSC gtexEqtlDapg)
evidence.mpravardb: experimental: MPRAVarDB allele pairs tested in massively parallel reporter assays
evidence.replication_timing: measured: ENCODE UW Repli-seq wavelet-smoothed signal (hg19, 11 cell lines, mean; high = early), lifted to hg38 per kilobase through UCSC's hg38ToHg19 chain

control.rule: the checks are stated in code (control_verdict) and were written after the first chr21 read of the coding and neutral numbers, so they describe the ordering seen rather than a prediction; 'overwhelmingly core' (80% of callable genes) is reported beside them, not required

sample_sizes.panel: 19 haplotype assemblies (hg38 is the coordinate system and not counted)
sample_sizes.gnomad: gnomAD v4.1.1 genomes, AN per site (up to 152,430 alleles)
sample_sizes.trexplorer: TenK10K allele counts per locus as stated (typically 3,850), HPRC where given

per_kilobase.definition: a kilobase outside canonical CDS with 90% or more aligned; Gnocchi constrained at mean Z >= 2.18; panel depleted at a Poisson lower tail <= 0.05 against the GC and timing matched rate

calibration.note: the calibration loci do not depend on the chromosome read

genome_wide.memory_note: a store is held in memory with its events; chr21 used about 1 GB, chr1 and chr2 would need 5 to 6 GB
